<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Pusk (Sloth Demon)](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2895)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Among the lowest and least powerful of all demons, the wretched pusks are just as vicious and cruel as their more powerful brethren. They happily vent their frustrations on anything weaker than themselves.

 Born from the souls of the slothful, these demons appear vaguely humanoid in appearance with awkward limbs and slack lumps of skin hanging from their frames. Supposedly, a single slothful soul of sufficient depravity and strength can spawn an entire horde of these creatures. However, as weaker demons, their lot in life is to suffer at the hands of more powerful Abyssal predators, and only a tiny number of pusks ever manage to become something more. For this reason, pusks are quite accommodating when summoned by mortals. They're usually content to work under conditions few other fiends would accept, although they'll still gladly turn on even the kindest of masters who show even the slightest hint of weakness.

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 2">[Pusk](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2895)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Small" />
<trait label="Demon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=573" />
<trait label="Fiend" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=600" />
<trait label="Unholy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=521" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 76

**Perception** +6; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Chthonian](/Languages.aspx?ID=114); [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=79) 100 feet

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +6, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +8, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +6, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +6

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +4

**Dex** +0

**Con** +4

**Int** -3

**Wis** +0

**Cha** +0
</row>

**Sloth** When a pusk regains their actions, roll 1d4. The pusk regains that many actions for the turn (to a maximum of 3, or 2 if the pusk is a [minion](/Traits.aspx?ID=653)). Effects like the [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) condition can further reduce their number of actions.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 17 

**Fort** +10 

**Ref** +4 

**Will** +8 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 36

</row>

**Weaknesses**
[cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=375) 3, [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517) 3

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +10 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)),
**Damage** 1d8+4 piercing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +10 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521)),
**Damage** 1d6+4 slashing

**Divine Innate Spells** DC 16
- **1st**
[Fear](/Spells.aspx?ID=110)
- **3rd**
[Slow](/Spells.aspx?ID=289)

**Rituals** DC 16

- **1st**
[Demonic Pact](/Rituals.aspx?ID=142)

**Cower** <actions string="Single Action" />  The pusk makes itself as small as possible, protecting its vital organs with its limbs. It gains a +4 circumstance bonus to AC but takes a –2 penalty to attack rolls. This lasts until the pusk moves from its current space, falls unconscious, or ends the effect as a free action.

**Frenzied Slashes** <actions string="Three Actions" />  The pusk makes three claw Strikes, each at a –2 penalty, all targeting the same creature. The pusk's multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it has made all three attacks. The pusk gains the [clumsy 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) condition until the beginning of its next turn.

**Vicious Criticals**   A pusk makes the most of any weakness it finds. Whenever a pusk scores a critical hit with its claw Strike, the target takes an additional 1d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29).

</column>
